primary_title: A distal locus element mediates IFN-gamma priming of lipopolysaccharide-stimulated TNF gene expression
decision_basis: The review identifies an IRF1-dependent distal TNF/LT enhancer; the cited primary demonstrates IFN-gamma-induced IRF1 recruitment to the TNF promoter and hHS-8 enhancer and loss of priming when IRF1 or its enhancer binding site is disrupted.
limitations_preserved: IRF1 recruitment and perturbation-supported IFN-gamma priming establish a bounded TNF gene transcription edge; preserve the secondary TLR stimulus and enhancer context, and do not infer TNF protein secretion or TNFR signaling automatically.

primary_title: Synergistic Activation of Inflammatory Cytokine Genes by Interferon-gamma-induced Chromatin Remodeling and Toll-like Receptor Signaling
decision_basis: The review describes coordinated STAT1 and IRF1 occupancy at inflammatory loci; the cited primary shows IFN-gamma-primed chromatin and enhanced LPS-induced transcription at the TNF locus with sustained STAT1/IRF1 promoter and enhancer occupancy.
limitations_preserved: Coordinated STAT1/IRF1 occupancy and priming-associated enhancement of LPS-induced TNF transcription support a bounded cooperative gene-activation edge; preserve IFN-gamma priming and TLR stimulus, and do not infer either factor alone is sufficient or infer TNF protein secretion automatically.
